authoring: ChatGPT-assisted plate-specific judgment; manually updated, with subjective scenario weights (not calibrated probabilities)
scope: U.S. discrete carbon steel plate (A36, A572 Grade 50, A516 Grade 70)
overall: Base case: U.S. discrete carbon steel plate pricing remains firm through Q1 2027, peaks or plateaus in Q2, then gradually softens in the second half as some supply returns. A rapid collapse is less likely than a slow normalization. Grade 50 and less common specifications may stay tighter than commodity A36.

quarters.rationale: SSAB reports a strong Q3 North American plate market, higher prices and somewhat low distributor inventories; Nucor announced a November plate increase. Near-term supply relief is unlikely to arrive quickly.
Extended plate mill lead times and import transit times should preserve mill leverage into early 2027. Rising prices may slow as buyers resist further increases.
My central call is a pricing plateau rather than continued rapid escalation. Some delayed production and imports could reach the market, but allocations may remain restrictive.
I favor modest easing as supply and inventory rebuild, assuming no new major outages or trade restrictions. Plate-specific mill capacity and specialty demand should limit downside.
My base case is a more balanced distributor market by late 2027, not a return to pre-shortage pricing. Structural trade barriers and uneven mill availability could prolong tightness.

key_watchpoints: Domestic plate mill allocations and available spot tons (not HRC allocations)
Published plate lead times and actual mill restart/output confirmation
Discrete plate import bookings, licenses and physical arrivals
Distributor inventories and replenishment versus shipments
A36 and A572-50 plate transaction quotes by thickness and width
Fabricator RFQ conversion, not merely inquiry volume

sources.name: SSAB Q3 2026 North American plate market commentary
Nucor November plate price increase reported by Steel Market Update (Oct 2, 2026)
Steel Warehouse September 2026 mill lead-time and import update

limitations: Quarter conviction scores and 55/30/15 scenario weights are explicitly subjective analyst judgments, not empirically calibrated probabilities. The previous broad steel PPI momentum backtest underperformed a naive baseline and is not used to claim forecast accuracy. No dollar/cwt targets without current verified grade-specific transactions. Supply and demand can shift quickly. The AI assessment is a dated snapshot, not continuously running ChatGPT.

scenarios.name: Base case — firm through early 2027, gradual H2 easing
scenarios.interpretation: Prices climb or hold into Q2, then soften modestly as domestic and import supply improves.

scenarios.name: Bull case — prolonged plate shortage
scenarios.interpretation: Mill allocations stay restricted, lead times stay long, and prices remain elevated or rise through late 2027.

scenarios.name: Bear case — faster supply and demand correction
scenarios.interpretation: Imports and mill output recover as end-user orders weaken, causing earlier and steeper price declines.
